Amer H
29 contributions

Not for dining
May 2019 • Solo
The place has a nice environment, but the food is mediocre. I was there solo, and wanted a western that night. I ordered the high end steak and a salad. The salad ingredients (veggies) were not fresh. I took a few bites just to pretend I had my greens. As for the steak, I won’t feed it to anyone, even those I am not a fan of. Granted, you get what you pay for. In this case a burger at McDonald’s would have been seriously a better choice. What was I thinking?

Ok, so the place is more to chill. Fun environment, good music, balcony setting, nice staff. If you want to meet with people over drinks and chats and laughs, but food quality doesn’t matter, then this is your place.
